title: Aegis
description: A single Rust binary covering black-box DAST, local-source SAST, real-CVE matching, and out-of-band collaboration.

branches.label: DAST — Live Site Scanning
branches.description: Network-facing checks that crawl a live target, fuzz it, and turn hits into verified findings.

nodes.title: Attack-surface discovery
nodes.description: Crawls same-origin links and forms, parses robots.txt/sitemap.xml, mines JS bundles for API endpoints, and Arjun-style brute-forces hidden parameter names before fuzzing.

nodes.title: 40 OWASP-mapped vulnerability checks
nodes.description: Covers injection (SQLi, NoSQLi, cmdi, SSTI, LDAP/XPath, log4shell), XSS/CSRF/SSRF/IDOR/JWT/GraphQL and more, each finding tagged with a WSTG v4.2 test ID, CWE, and CAPEC ref.

nodes.title: Verification & proof pass
nodes.description: Grades every finding confirmed/firm/tentative, extracts real proof (DB version via error-based SQLi, an /etc/passwd line for LFI, evaluated SSTI expressions), and emits a replayable curl PoC.

nodes.title: Out-of-band collaborator listener
nodes.description: A standalone collaborator binary that catches blind SSRF/stored-XSS callbacks over raw TCP, buckets hits by token, and persists them to a JSONL log.

branches.label: SAST — Static Source Analysis
branches.description: Offline scanning of a local source tree via --src, independent of any live target.

nodes.title: Tree-sitter rule engine
nodes.description: 11 language-aware queries (SQLi string-concat, command exec/eval, unsafe deserialization, weak crypto, path traversal, SSRF, open redirect, XSS sinks, disabled TLS verification, XPath/LDAP injection, weak PRNGs) across Rust/TS/TSX/JS/Python.

nodes.title: Hardcoded-secret scanner
nodes.description: Regex-based secret detection that lossily decodes non-UTF-8 files so a single invalid byte can't silently disable the rule for the whole file.

nodes.title: Self-scan feedback-loop guard
nodes.description: Canonicalized-path exclusion so re-running a scan over a tree containing this tool's own prior CVE-record output doesn't re-detect its own evidence text as new secrets.

branches.label: CVE Intelligence & Reporting
branches.description: Turns findings into real, referenceable vulnerability records instead of ad-hoc log lines.

nodes.title: Real-CVE matching (OSV/NVD)
nodes.description: Fingerprints component@version from server banners and queries OSV.dev plus optional NVD to attach genuine, matched CVEs instead of guesses.

nodes.title: CVE-record writer
nodes.description: Persists every finding as a cvelistV5-shaped JSON record, giving self-discovered issues honest PENTEST-LOCAL IDs rather than fabricating a real-looking CVE number.

nodes.title: Standards-mapped reporting
nodes.description: Every finding carries WSTG/CWE/CAPEC refs plus JSON/HTML report output and stable exit codes built for CI gating and agent/script consumption.
